Softech Associate Panama City Beach, Florida, United States

Job Title

Software Engineer (Remote)

Job Description

Join Softech Associate to build and ship real software for our clients. We are looking for engineers with strong fundamentals and excellent communication who want to grow on a remote-first team.

What we're looking for

  • Strong foundational knowledge of computer science and software engineering
  • Comfort with data structures, algorithms, system design, and clean coding principles
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and logically
  • Advanced-level English communication skills
  • Confidence and clarity when reasoning through technical problems

Restrictions

  • No telecommuting
  • Agencies are OK

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain real client projects across the stack
  • Participate in system design discussions and coding tasks
  • Collaborate in mock interviews and technical discussions to grow as a team
  • Communicate progress and trade-offs clearly with the team and clients
  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code

Preferred technical background

Frontend React · Next.js · TypeScript · JavaScript

Backend Node.js · Python · FastAPI · Flask · Express

Databases PostgreSQL · MongoDB · MySQL

Cloud AWS · Azure · GCP

Experience with AI tools, LLMs, or modern developer platforms is a plus.

About the Company

Softech Associate is a software engineering and IT consulting company based in Florida. They help companies build and modernize software, covering full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, system design, databases, and AI solutions. From what I saw, they work as a remote-first engineering partner and can support clients with full projects, dedicated engineering teams, or technical consulting.

name: fixture lever opening
html:
Ro is a direct-to-patient healthcare company with a mission of helping patients achieve their health goals by delivering the easiest, most effective care possible. Ro is the only company to offer nationwide telehealth, labs, and pharmacy services. This is enabled by Ro's vertically integrated platform that helps patients achieve their goals through a convenient, end-to-end healthcare experience spanning from diagnosis, to delivery of medication, to ongoing care. Since 2017, Ro has helped millions of patients in nearly every single county in the United States, including 99% of primary care deserts.
 
Ro is consistently recognized as a top workplace in Health Care, in New York, and for Women and Parents—earning more than 20 honors from Fortune, Great Place to Work, and PEOPLE since 2021. In 2025 alone, we ranked top 5 among medium workplaces in Health Care and New York, and top 50 nationwide.
